stem: It is known that 1 in 5000 people in Atalia have a certain condition. A random sample of $12\,500$ people from Atalia is chosen for a medical trial. The number having the condition is denoted by $X$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Use an appropriate approximating distribution to find $\text{P}(X \leqslant 3)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the values of $\text{E}(X)$ and $\text{Var}(X)$, and explain how your answers suggest that the approximating distribution used in **(a)** is likely to be appropriate.
